_meta.name: eks-language-config-template
_meta.derived_from: 107 unique EKS deployments in stage/ap-south-1 present in BOTH infrastructure-v2 and k8s-manifests (see eks-template-source-services.json).

logic.sample_unit: one deployment directory = one sample; duplicate DB rows dropped
logic.effective_value: a key absent from a service's values.yaml is NOT missing - it is the platform-base default that actually renders, so the default is counted
logic.scalar_fields: MODE (most frequent value); ties resolve to the lower value
logic.list_fields: per-element majority - a policy is included when >50% of services attach it
logic.conditional_fields: hpa min/max counted only over services with autoscaling on; replica_count only over services with it off
logic.gate: null unless >=5 samples and the winner holds >=30%
logic.port_note: mode only - a median of port numbers is meaningless
logic.units: cpu in cores, memory in GB - converted from 500m / 2048Mi as the form stores them
logic.replica_fields: autoscaling decides which side applies: hpa on carries min/max only, hpa off carries replica_count only. The form activates one or the other, never both, and rejects an answer for the inactive side.
logic.placeholders: {service_name} and {service_path} are resolved per service, not stored: they depend on what the user names the service, so they cannot be a fixed value the way a CPU request can.

fixed_by_decision.alb_schema: internal - service_configs has it on 57 of 57 online EKS services; the manifests the rest of this template was derived from do not carry it
fixed_by_decision.build_args: [] - the frontend offers build args for every language but they are empty on all but a handful of services, so the template leaves them unset rather than asking every time. Anyone who needs one still says so.
fixed_by_decision.port: 8080 for every language - one container port across the platform
fixed_by_decision.service_path: /{service_name} - the name normalised the way the manifests already do it (lowercase, spaces and underscores to hyphens, a -service suffix), so helloworld / helloworld-service / helloworld_service all reach /helloworld-service
fixed_by_decision.health: {service_path}/actuator/health for the Java languages, Spring Boot putting its readiness probe under Actuator; {service_path}/health for the rest
